name: mirage
text: Got the screenshot. It shows the same thing: that board counts only the ESPN-scoreboard lane (US team sports with a clock), and the Pinnacle-fed lane that prices tennis (now on, paper) shows only a one-line status. I'm adding that lane's counts to its status line (games in the feed, in play, in Novig, matched, lines priced) and restarting the engine on it, so the next look shows exactly where tennis drops out instead of a bare 0. I'll report what it says.
